scripts.build:landing: REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=landing node scripts/write-target-entry.js && REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=landing react-scripts build && REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=landing node scripts/write-target-headers.js
scripts.build:webapp: REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=webapp node scripts/write-target-entry.js && REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=webapp react-scripts build && REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=webapp node scripts/write-target-headers.js
scripts.build:webapp:native: npm run build:webapp:android && npm run native-update:package
scripts.verify:landing: npm run build:landing && node scripts/verify-landing-build.js && REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=landing node scripts/verify-target-headers.js
scripts.verify:webapp: npm run build:webapp && REACT_APP_SITE_TARGET=webapp node scripts/verify-target-headers.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run test -- --runInBand && npm run build
scripts.verify:e2ee: npm run test:e2ee && npm run build
scripts.verify:e2ee:acceptance-preflight: npm run lint && npm run test:e2ee -- --runInBand
scripts.verify:cloudflare: npm run lint && npm run test -- --runInBand && npm run verify:public-headers && npm run test:deployed-targets && npm run verify:landing && npm run verify:webapp
scripts.android:build: npm run build:webapp:android && npm run android:sync && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=../.gradle-android ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:build:play: npm run android:version:bump && cd android && GRADLE_USER_HOME=../.gradle-android ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:run:emulator: npm run android:build && npm run android:install
scripts.android:doctor: bash -lc 'export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-$HOME/Android/Sdk}; export PATH=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/emulator:$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$PATH; echo ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT; adb version; emulator -list-avds; adb devices'
